title: Moroccan Chicken Tagine
description: A traditional North African stew made with chicken, rice, and aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat oil in the bottom of a large clay tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the tagine spice blend, chicken broth, and uncooked rice to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover the pot.
Simmer the tagine for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the rice is tender.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve the tagine hot.
